brief: A resort-town cottage lot: Earl Young 'mushroom house': a low cottage of rounded fieldstone walls under a thick undulating cedar-shake roof with curled eaves. One photo; year estimated. Older than 1970: northern Michigan resort cottages of this kind are 1880-1950 buildings; Commons has almost no newer ones. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).

facade.notes: a 'Mushroom House' by Earl Young (Charlevoix MI, 1948): a cottage of big rounded fieldstones and boulders under a wavy, curling cedar-shake roof that rolls down at the eaves, a stuccoed chimney; a dry-laid flagstone wall along the front
